name: fixlat-dashboard-lambda
description: Función AWS Lambda para cálculo de métricas del dashboard

scripts.start: node -e "const app = require('./app'); require('http').createServer(async (req, res) => { const result = await app.handler({}); res.writeHead(result.statusCode, result.headers || {}); res.end(result.body); }).listen(3001, () => console.log('Lambda local ejecutándose en puerto 3001'));"
